entries.title: Psalms 149:1
segments:
PSALM CXLIX. 
 
  An exhortation to praise God for his love to his people, ver. 1-5.   And for enabling them to overcome their enemies, ver. 6-9.

entries.title: Psalms 149:4
segments: V. 4. The Lord-He rejoiceth over them to do them good. Beautify-Heb. adorn, make them amiable and honourable in the eyes of the world, who now hate and despise them. The meek-All true Israelites are such.

entries.title: Psalms 149:5
segments: V. 5. In glory-For the honour which God putteth upon them. Beds-By night as well as by day.

entries.title: Psalms 149:7
segments: V. 7. Vengeance-For all their cruelties and injuries towards God's people.  This was literally accomplished by David upon the Philistines, Ammonites, Syrians and other neighbouring nations.

entries.title: Psalms 149:9
segments: V. 9. Written-Appointed and declared in the holy scripture.
